description:
Constructed from coated welded steel, this Anti-roll Bar is designed to be durable and reliable. It ensures the safety of both you and your machinery through its Anti-roll Bar protection slots.
Fitment
Its versatile design allows for a wide range of tasks, such as moving logs, wood, and firewood, transporting fence posts and hay bales, clearing debris and bushes, and more. It is widely used for efficient loading and unloading in farms, factories, warehouses, and construction sites.
Features
Anti-roll Bar: It is from coated welded steel construction. Durable and reliable.Anti-roll Bar protection slots will keep you and your machinery safe.
Adjustable Stabilizer Bar: Use adjustable stabilizer bar to conveniently prevent your forks from spreading apart, your problem can be solved.The stabilizer bar can be adjusted from 18" to 34" W.
Thickened protection plate on both sides: Built with coated, welded steel that is durable and reliable to achieve a bearing capacity of up to 4,000lbs;Two side thickened guard plate effectively prevents deformation.
Easy Installation & Versatile: You can use it to move logs, wood, and firewood, transport fence posts and hay bales, clear debris and bushes, and more. Widely used in efficient loading and unloading in farms, factories and warehouses, construction Site.
